data.research_question: What authoritative evidence narrows Democracy Partners' Suite 250 versus Suite 330 Washington office history, and what materially new current DNC governance event should be ingested without duplicating the already-recorded 2028 calendar vote?
data.method: Refreshed current main at 9ad617a08eddeb10901f81ca00f8ccd172fd2edd and re-read the current repository contract, Auto-Dig, corpus-search, document-creation, recursive-target, validation, data-import, Free-Range, and executable v0.9.0 schema surfaces. Enumerated 27 physical dig roots. Excluded free-range as the meta-root and excluded cloarida, greater-israel, and tech-bro under the previous-three-successful-hourly anti-repeat rule, leaving 23 physical dataset/topic roots. Dataset seed 11169418870518503415 was derived from SHA-256(main|2026-08-18T10:53:20Z|hourly-auto-dig|dataset-first-v1). The seeded dataset draw sequence first selected occrp-aleph, whose only explicit target is blocked by missing accessible Aleph collections; Free-Range excludes blocked work by default. Continuing the same deterministic RNG sequence rejected canada-policy-influence, trump-thiel-circle, and lexisnexis-risk-state-surveillance because connector search surfaced no queued actionable target in those roots, then selected dnc with an explicit queued target. Target seed 1708806166567557544, derived from SHA-256(main|2026-08-18T10:53:20Z|dnc|target-stage-v1), selected starintel:investigation-target:democracy-partners-washington-suite-history from the fresh surfaced DNC queue. The exact whole-corpus actionable-target count is not fabricated because connector code search cannot execute Free-Range's complete DB+packet terminal-state, blocker, deduplication, and discovered-candidate semantics. Location/HQ research used the current first-party Democracy Partners contact page plus a 2020 D.D.C. opinion. The opinion establishes Suite 250 usage in 2016, while the current first-party page lists Suite 330; the exact transition date remains unresolved and no headquarters street or coordinates are inferred. After the location slice, current-news search deduplicated the already-ingested August 15 DNC primary-calendar event and instead ingested AP reporting on the same-day approval of separate non-binding ICE reform and abolition resolutions, preserving that they do not set the 2028 platform and do not constitute one unified position.
classification_rules: Use dataset-first seeded selection and continue the same RNG sequence when a drawn dataset has no actionable Free-Range target.
Exclude blocked, completed, closed, cancelled, rejected, and superseded work from the actionable frontier.
Historical office use does not establish the exact effective date of a later move.
A public office street address is not a headquarters street without explicit headquarters semantics.
Separate non-binding resolutions with conflicting policy directions must not be flattened into one unified party position.
A DNC resolution vote does not itself set the 2028 party platform when the reporting explicitly states otherwise.

findings.finding: A D.D.C. opinion states Democracy Partners operated from Suite 250 at 1250 Eye Street NW in 2016.
Democracy Partners' current first-party contact page lists Suite 330 at the same 1250 Eye Street NW address.
The exact effective date of the Suite 250 to Suite 330 transition remains unresolved.
The DNC approved separate non-binding ICE reform and abolition resolutions on August 15, 2026; they did not set the 2028 platform.
